svg.aria-label: Placement Committee System: A full-stack operations portal for the IMB 9 placement committee: a workspace for each wing, cross-wing requests, event approvals with email alerts, Excel import and export, and a log of who changed what. It replaced the separate Excel trackers the wings used to keep.
